name: mk2-hud
description: Mk2-HUD: a heads-up display above the Claude Code prompt. Reads Claude's replies aloud with a local Piper voice, tracks the plan and its subagents, and shows turn, speed, cost, prompt cache and context.

planReports.title: Ask Claude to report its plans
planReports.description: Adds a short note to Claude's system prompt so it reports multi-step work to the mission row; off, the row follows only task lists and subagents
